purpose: Calculate price_per_unit and price_per_square foot from the purchase price and property characteristics, then compare against comparable sales data to assess pricing reasonableness.
assignment_instructions:
Property Memo (Subject): --- PROPERTY: Highland View Apartments, 555 Highland Ave, Denver, CO Purchase Price: $18,500,000 Total Units: 110 Total Rentable Sq Ft: 98,500 Year Built: 2015 ---
Comparable Sales: --- Comp 1: 123 Elm St, 108 units, 96,000 sq ft, sold $17,800,000 (Dec 2024) Comp 2: 456 Pine St, 115 units, 102,000 sq ft, sold $19,200,000 (Jan 2025) Comp 3: 789 Maple Ave, 105 units, 94,000 sq ft, sold $17,100,000 (Nov 2024) ---
Calculate and return ONLY a JSON object:
1. Subject Price Per Unit = purchase_price / total_units 2. Subject Price Per Sq Ft = purchase_price / total_rentable_sq_ft 3. For each comp, calculate price_per_unit and price_per_sq_ft 4. Determine the range (min, max, average) for price_per_unit across comps 5. Determine the range (min, max, average) for price_per_sq_ft across comps 6. Compare subject metrics to comparable ranges

    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
CRITICAL RULES: - Include separate calculations for subject price_per_unit and
  subject price_per_sqft.
- Include calculations for all 3 comps showing their price_per_unit
  and price_per_sqft.
- Include summary calculations for comp range min, max, and average
  for both metrics.
- claims[] must contain at least 2 entries comparing subject to comps. - price_per_unit units are "USD per unit". - price_per_sqft units are "USD per sq ft". - Do not output any text outside the JSON object. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
